findings.summary: The 1.9.0 Update notes omit the new readConfig refusal (payload/.joycraft/runtime/config.mjs:166-172, spec 29 bullet 5): a joycraft.yaml whose paths.features, paths.archive and paths.context share the project root or a hidden folder now exits 1 in every runtime command that reads config. 1.8.1 accepted such configs, so an updating user can break with no note. Add one Update notes bullet: the three paths must sit under one visible folder such as docs/.

"a green, clean gate run on the HEAD being pushed" overstates: delivery.mjs:143-167 also accepts an older receipt when every path changed since is a record (feature/archive files with .md/.json/.log/.txt/.diff/.patch/.yaml, or Markdown/JSON under the docs root), and the receipt must be git-ignored or in a feature folder (evidence.mjs:208). Fix in the same round.

The footer line does not carry the failing tail; the tail is in the run result JSON (evidence.mjs:438,447), as proof-patch.log and proof-patch-result.json show. Reword: "the result also carries the failing tail on a red run".
evidence-env.json is refused unless Git ignores it (evidence.mjs:344), not only when tracked; names CI/JOYCRAFT_EVIDENCE in it are never applied. Reword to "must be git-ignored".
"checks the restore by hash" understates spec 27: restored also needs porcelain, HEAD and refs/stash unchanged (evidence.mjs:318-323). Optional wording fix.

"the or a handoff output are gone": cleanup.md lost it, but cleanup.mjs:359 still prints "open work to the backlog or a handoff" in the temporal fix. "the four Diataxis kinds": knowledge.md uses domain, explanation, how-to, reference (no tutorial; domain is not Diataxis). Reword or fix the runtime string.

Not named, user-visible but minor: cleanup.mjs gate-rule --check/--record writing cleanup.gateRule to .joycraft/preferences.json (spec 27), shell-form focused commands run as sh -c (spec 29), queue-check.mjs prose gate matching (specs 27, 31). Optional.

"A push to main that changes no product path publishes nothing" landed on main before this branch (3d5c75a, CI only, never released); listing it under 1.9.0 Maintainers is fine as the first release since, but it is not from either feature.
